thread:
maria-partnerships: FYI vendor (RetailHW) just flagged that our PO RWH-8921 failed their portal validation. They say signer was rotated in their system this morning and our routing/ wiring mismatch now.

sara-finance: Ugh. Do they mean the ACH/routing number changed or the authorized signer on the PO?

maria-partnerships: They attached a rejection screenshot. Quote: "signer mismatch - authority not on file". Also says wiring beneficiary name doesn't match ledger (RetailHW LLC vs Retail Hardware Inc).

vendor-inbound-bot: [system] Incoming vendor message attached: invoice_8921.pdf (uploaded)

lina-sales: I spoke to their AM earlier — they rotated signatory as part of org restructure. They can provide an updated signed PO + new W9, but legal said we need an MSA amendment if signatory authority changed.

ryan-legal: If signatory authority changed and it's a different legal entity name, we need evidence (board resolution or new signing authority letter) OR an executed amendment referencing contract id: MSA-2023-004.

alex-ops: For go/no-go on provisioning, what's the minimal finance docs? can we accept a signed PO + updated W9 for now?

sara-finance: We can process payment with signed PO + W9 only if vendor bank details are verified. But ACH beneficiary name mismatch will fail bank-level verification. We need vendor bank confirmation or a bank letter.

maria-partnerships: RetailHW offered a bank letter PDF but it's on their letterhead dated today. They want to push provisioning asap.

ryan-legal: Bank letter + signed PO + updated W9 + signed amendment (if entity name changed) OR signed statement that the entity is a DBA of the same legal entity.

lina-sales: Can we accept a DBA declaration to unblock provisioning for a pilot (non-production) while documents are being finalized?

sara-finance: For pilots we sometimes do a limited prepay/hold policy. But that requires Sales sign-off and a purchase order that references "pilot - conditional payment" and payment hold until docs clear.

alex-ops: Technically we can route to a sandbox SKU if Sales issues a pilot PO. Ops just needs the PO number and confirmation that no production credits will be consumed.

maria-partnerships: OK pushing to RetailHW: please provide (1) signed PO with the exact legal name as on bank letter, (2) updated W9, (3) bank confirmation letter. If the legal name changed please include board/attorney confirmation or an MSA amendment counter-signed. Meanwhile, can Sales issue a "pilot" PO to unblock sandbox access? @lina-sales

lina-sales: I can issue a pilot PO today for up to $5k and mark as "conditional - docs pending". Will confirm with Sara for prepay flow.

sara-finance: I'll accept the pilot PO and hold payment until docs clear, but we need a vendor contact + email verified. Also cc finance-ops@redwood.ai on their bank letter.

maria-partnerships: RetailHW rep: vendor.contact@retailhw.com. I'll escalate and request the three docs + bank contact.

vendor-inbound-bot: [system] RetailHW uploaded bank_letter_2026-03-21.pdf and updated_w9.pdf.

ryan-legal: I'll review the bank letter & W9. If bank letter matches W9 name and PO name -> legal can waive immediate amendment for pilot only. Full MSA amendment will be needed for production billing.

alex-ops: Once Sales sends pilot PO number, ping me and I'll open sandbox instance and whitelist their account.

maria-partnerships: Action items: @lina-sales to issue pilot PO (today), @sara-finance to confirm prepay/hold, @ryan-legal to review uploads, RetailHW to deliver bank confirmation signed. I'll thread with RetailHW now. :pray:

lina-sales: Sending pilot PO now (PO: PILOT-RWH-0007). Marking notes: conditional payment, docs pending.

sara-finance: Got PO. I'll set up prepay hold, emailing retailhw.finance for bank contact verification.

ryan-legal: Reviewing attachments. Quick note: bank_letter has routing + acct suffix obfuscated — ask for redacted full bank confirmation via bank on letterhead (template below).

ryan-legal: ```Please provide a bank confirmation letter on bank letterhead confirming account holder name, account number (full or last 4), routing number, and signed by an authorized bank officer.```

maria-partnerships: Sent that ask. RetailHW replied they can get bank to send direct email to finance. I'll update thread when bank email arrives.

vendor-inbound-bot: [system] RetailHW bank confirmation email received: bank@firstnationalbank.com (contains acct last4: 1234).

sara-finance: Verified bank email domain matches bank. Good. I'll match last4 and routing, then clear for payment. Pilot sandbox can be enabled.

alex-ops: Received PO and confirmation, provisioning in progress. ETA ~20m for sandbox access.

maria-partnerships: Thanks all. Summary for record: Pilot PO issued (PILOT-RWH-0007), temporary sandbox enabled; finance holding payment until docs cleared for production. Legal to track MSA amendment for production. Closing once MSA signed. :white_check_mark:
